column3: MT 75:1–2; the following verses of this psalm are MT +1. NASB sets the title in braces before verse 1; “and Your name is near” is rendered “For Your name is near.”
Close to the Hebrew; NASB sets verses 2–5 as God's words.
Close to the Hebrew; “with an arrogant neck” is rendered “with insolent pride.”
Close to the Hebrew; “the going out” and “the setting place” are rendered “the east” and “the west.”
Close to the Hebrew; NASB supplies “it.”
The Hebrew has “I will cut off”; NASB renders “He will cut off.”
